mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in > 60% of months where PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 9.5% signals a severe labor market contraction, which typically precedes a recession and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 9.5%, the 20d forward returns are positive in > 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based contraction in the real economy, which reduces corporate profitability and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative 20d returns are not observed when both INDPRO and HOUST decline by more than 2% in the prior month (i.e., the interaction signal fails to predict negative returns in > 50% of such cases).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a CPIAUCSL reading above 2.5% annualized signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to further tighten policy and causing S&P 500 forward returns to decline over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, the 20d forward returns are positive in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in > 60% of months where RSAFS increases by at least 0.3% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95% of its 12-month moving average, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 95% of its 12-month moving average, the 20d forward returns are positive in > 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and GDPC1 decline by more than 1% in the prior quarter, the 60d forward returns are positive in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, which lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are negative in > 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points.
